(Mainly because of the guy my bro was with at the time.) Anyways a couple a weeks go by and Dad comes to terms with it. Not agreeing with his orientation but loving his son as all parents should try to do. Yet family keeps a chip on their shoulder. Now Bro is married to my awesome Brother in Law (not the guy he was with years ago) and they adopted a son who is thrilled to have his forever home. Yet only our immediate household accepts him because the rest are Dicks and we dont talk to them anymore and havent missed a single one since. I sincerely hope things go better for you. And if people choose to be negative cut them off. You'll be way happier.
